profile_text.body:
Craft Ventures is a for-profit investor headquartered in San Francisco, CA. Its website currently highlights a third investment in Horizon3, backing a $250M Series E at a $2B+ valuation. The site describes Horizon3's autonomous AI hacking as critical for continuous security validation, trusted by 7,000+ organizations including four Fortune 10 companies.

Craft Ventures does not list its own AI products in the available data. Its AI position is expressed through the Horizon3 investment, which the company's site frames around autonomous AI hacking for security validation.

The available record associates Craft Ventures with 281 California legal exposure entries, though no individual legal cases are named. No products are listed for the firm.
